author: nemi
text: Look, I saw free pudding on a school volunteer form, and I signed before I reached the part explaining what I'd volunteered for. You're taking over before I make it worse. Drag to look around and press one to start. On phones, swipe and use numbered chapters. If you're paused, press play.
